threads.title: Analytics & Dashboard Interactivity
threads.context: Adding analytics tab, capturing project screenshots, making dashboard interactive with 3-color scheme
threads.summary: Added comprehensive analytics features including code stats, git history, session analytics with detailed history view, and screenshots gallery. Made dashboard fully interactive with clickable stat boxes and pie chart for filtering projects. Updated to consistent 3-color scheme (orange/blue/green) across progress bars and charts.
tasksCompleted: Added Analytics types (CodeStats, GitStats, SessionAnalytics, Thread, Screenshot)
Implemented Rust commands for code stats and git history
Created Analytics component with code/git/session stats
Added session history with summaries, tasks, duration, outcomes
Added screenshots gallery to Analytics tab
Captured homepage screenshots for deployed projects (Carspex, AI Voice, Portfolio)
Made stat boxes clickable to filter by status
Made pie chart slices clickable to filter by stage
Added filter badge with clear button
Updated progress bars to 3-color scheme (green >= 75%, blue >= 40%, orange < 40%)
Updated pie chart to 3-color scheme (orange/blue/green)

threads.title: Feature Expansion & Bug Fixes
threads.context: Adding services tab, editable notes/focus, progress tracking, and fixing Tauri 2 invoke issues
threads.summary: Added comprehensive project management features including Services tab with start/stop controls, editable notes and focus fields, progress/burndown tracking visualization, and project editor for status/progress. Fixed critical Tauri 2 bug where invoke commands weren't reaching Rust due to camelCase/snake_case parameter mismatch.
tasksCompleted: Added Services tab with running status indicators
Implemented Start All / Stop All service controls

Made current focus editable
Added Recent Sessions display from threads.json
Created ProgressChart component with burndown tracking
Added ProjectEditor for status and progress editing
Added Goals section display
Fixed Tauri 2 invoke parameter naming (camelCase vs snake_case)
Added #[tauri::command(rename_all = "camelCase")] to Rust commands
